title: IBM Guardium Key Lifecycle Manager 4.1, 4.1.1, 4.2, 4.2.1, 5.0, and 5.1 could allow a local attacker to obtain…
description: IBM Guardium Key Lifecycle Manager versions 4.1, 4.1.1, 4.2, 4.2.1, 5.0, and 5.1 contain a vulnerability due to the use of a weak cryptographic algorithm. This flaw could allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.8.
